senses.gloss: f. (טְעַן II) laden, carrying. [Targ. I Sam. XVI, 20, v. טְעוּנָא.] Targ. Esth. II, 15 טְעִינַת טיבו (h. text נשאת חן).—
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:13">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>ממון אתית ט׳ וכ׳</he> that I came laden with money; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">I</cite> bring only words.—Pl. (<he>טְעוּ׳</he>) <cite ref="I00268"><he>טְעִינִין</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="I00606"><he>טְעִינָן</he></cite>.
